directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN:
A horde of fleshes keeps running in circles. Suddenly the leader stops and says: "So, brethren... Have we made GREAT noise?"
\n"Yes, we have!"
\n"Have we raised TONNES of dust in the air?"
\n"Yes, yes, we have!!!"
\n"We are almost like HORSES, then!"

entries.JA_new:
フレッシュの群れがぐるぐる走り回ってた。するとリーダーが立ち止まって言った。「兄弟たち……でっけえ音を立てたか？」
\n「立てたぞ！」
\n「ものすごい砂ぼこりを巻き上げたか？」
\n「そうとも、巻き上げた！」
\n「じゃあ俺たち、馬みたいなもんだな！」

entries.EN: It's not clothes that make the man, out here it is only the man that makes the difference, his clothes be damned. The Zone ain't a bar with a backroom brothel and cheap whores, nor is it a kindergarten. See what I'm getting at here? Ya can get yourself some pro gear and a cool shooter, have money to burn and swim in artifacts, but if yer head is full of shit and you get caught with your hands in your pockets, you'll get wasted just like that! No second chances for ya, one mistake is all you get! I'm telling ya, be attentive! Pay attention! Eyes peeled at all times! Otherwise, you'll end up just like Vitka Nosy. I told him hundreds o'times, "Don't walk by these gaps, don't go over there!" He wouldn't listen! Now we can't even find his body. \nJust got a message on the PDA - "Stalker died: Vitka Nosy. Cause of death: unknown..."

entries.JA_new: 人間を作るのは服じゃない。大事なのは本人だ。服なんてどうでもいい。ゾーンは、裏に売春宿と安酒場があるような場所でも、幼稚園でもない。言いたいこと、分かるか？どんな一流の装備や銃を持ってても、金を唸るほど抱えてアーティファクトに囲まれてても、頭が空っぽでぼさっとしてたら、あっという間に殺される！やり直しはきかない。失敗は一度で終わりだ！いいか、注意しろ！周りをよく見ろ！いつだって目を光らせておけ！そうしないと、ヴィトカ・ノージーみたいになる。あいつには何百回も言ったんだ。「あの隙間を通るな、そっちへ行くな！」ってな。なのに聞かなかった！今じゃ死体すら見つからない。 \nPDAに通知が来た――「ストーカー死亡：ヴィトカ・ノージー。死因：不明……」

entries.EN: Yeah, you've managed to piss off quite a few of the stalkers around here, better fix your act now or they'll get together and put you out of your misery while you sleep. I won't always be around to cover for you and it's a ruthless world out there, the stalkers have a way of cleaning out the bad apples, know what I mean? Remember, Marked One, that trust and reputation are often the only things a stalker can rely on to survive in the Zone and you're throwing both away... Now then, I'll try to salvage your reputation, but you'll have to earn back their trust. Give me 20 grand and you can sleep peacefully tonight, as all your sins are washed away, he-he-he...

entries.JA_new: あんた、この辺のストーカーをかなり怒らせたな。今のうちに態度を改めないと、連中が徒党を組んで寝てる間に始末しに来るぞ。俺がいつまでもかばえるわけじゃない。ここは容赦のない場所だ。悪党を片づけるのがストーカー流ってやつさ。分かるだろ？いいか、マークド・ワン。ゾーンで生き延びるには、信頼と評判が頼りになる。あんたはその両方を捨ててるんだ……さて、評判を立て直してやる。だが、信頼を取り戻すのはあんた自身だ。2万ルーブル払えば、今夜は安心して眠れるようにしてやるよ。罪もきれいさっぱり消してな。へへへ……

entries.EN: Ah, in walks the devil himself. Marked One, I did not save you from that Death Truck and nurture you back to health only for you to turn feral and eliminate all my potential customers! I don't know what kind of problems you have with the loners but I suggest you put it aside because you're seriously pissing all over my business here! Ok, you want me to fix things up? You'll have to pay up! For all the losses you've cost me, you'll have to hand over 40k and I'll try to put things right, no guarantees though. Now, get out of here and lay low until I fix your mess.

entries.JA_new: おやおや、悪魔のお出ましか。マークド・ワン、死のトラックから助けて、ここまで回復させてやったのは、あんたを野獣にして客を皆殺しにさせるためじゃないぞ！ローナーと何があったか知らんが、いい加減にしろ。俺の商売をぶち壊しにする気か！分かった、俺に仲裁してほしいんだな？なら、金を払え！あんたのせいで被った損害もある。4万ルーブル出せば、何とか話をつけてみる。うまくいく保証はないがな。さあ、出ていけ。片をつけるまで身を隠してろ。

entries.EN: Look who it is, in walks Hitler's incarnate, the Zone's own fucking death machine! How many stalkers have you wasted so far today, you stupid psychopath? I should have you put down like a rabid dog, give me one good reason why I should let you leave this bunker alive?? Killing you would be so good for business, all the stalkers around would party all night, and I'd get to sell a shit ton of booze. After all your mess, you think you get to just walk in here and ask me to put things right?! How exactly do you expect me to do that?? Only solution I see is to put a bullet in your skull! Fuck, I need a drink... Okay, Marked One, you reached out, you came to me, I respect that you had guts to walk right into the camp here to talk peace. I'll throw you a bone and give you a chance to pay me back for the hardships you caused to my establishment. Hand over 60 thousand rubles, and I'll work on trying to make this carnage look like somebody else's work, a stolen PDA, some type of merc frame job, whatever... Give me time to think, meanwhile go hide yourself and don't show your face back here for a while!

entries.JA_new: 誰かと思えば、ヒトラーの生まれ変わり、ゾーンの殺人マシーン様か！今日だけで何人のストーカーを殺したんだ、このサイコ野郎？狂犬みたいに撃ち殺してやりたいが、ここから生きて出してやる理由を一つでも言ってみろ！あんたを殺せば商売は大繁盛だ。ストーカーどもは朝まで宴会、俺は酒を山ほど売りさばける。散々騒ぎを起こしたくせに、ここへ来て仲裁しろだと！？どうやって収めろってんだ！？俺に思いつくのは、頭に弾をぶち込むことだけだ！くそっ、酒が要る……分かったよ、マークド・ワン。あんたから話をしに来たんだな。キャンプに踏み込んで和平を求める度胸は認めてやる。迷惑料を払うなら、手を貸してやってもいい。6万ルーブル置いていけ。盗まれたPDAだの、マーセナリーズの濡れ衣だの、何か別の連中の仕業に見せかけて、この惨状を何とかしてやる……考える時間をくれ。とりあえず隠れて、しばらく顔を見せるな！

entries.EN: Ok. Here's hoping the loners take it easy from now on.
entries.JA_current: Ok. Here's hoping the loners take it easy from now on.
entries.JA_new: 分かった。これからはローナーも大人しくしてくれるといいな。

entries.EN: Alright. Less fighting means less trouble.
entries.JA_current: Alright. Less fighting means less trouble.
entries.JA_new: よし。争いが減れば、面倒も減る。

entries.EN: Got a job for you, Marked One... I want you to find a stalker called Nimble, he was carrying some very important information. He disappeared somewhere near the bridge. Find him, dead or alive - I don't care, I need the flash drive with the info. Visit Wolf from the local camp, and ask him. He certainly knows where that guy can be.
entries.JA_current: じゃあ仕事があるぜ、Marked one。お前さんには Nimble というストーカーを探して欲しい。奴はとっても大切な情報を運んでたんだが、橋の辺りで消えちまった。生死は問わない。俺は Flash Driveに入ってる筈の情報が欲しいんだ。上のキャンプにいる Wolf って奴の所に行ってきな。そいつなら何処に Nimble がいるか知ってる筈さ。
entries.JA_new: 仕事があるぞ、マークド・ワン……ニンブルというストーカーを探してくれ。重要な情報を持っていたんだが、橋の近くで行方不明になった。生死は問わない。情報の入ったフラッシュドライブが必要なんだ。地元キャンプのウルフを訪ねて聞いてみろ。あいつなら、ニンブルの居場所を知ってるはずだ。

entries.EN: Is that it?
entries.JA_current: あれか？
entries.JA_new: あれで全部か？

entries.EN: Wait. Here, take this pistol and ammo. You won't last two seconds in the Zone without a weapon! By the way, when you were brought here, you had a knife. I took it off you just in case your head wasn't quite working. You look OK though, so here it is.
entries.JA_current: 待て。ほら、このピストルと弾薬を持って行け。武器無しじゃ、ゾーンでは2秒も持たないだろう！ ところで、ここに連れて来られたとき、お前はナイフを持っていた。まだ頭が働いていないかもと、お前からナイフを取り上げた。もう大丈夫に見えるな、ほらこれだ。
entries.JA_new: 待て。ほら、このピストルと弾を持っていけ。武器なしじゃ、ゾーンで二秒ももたないぞ！そういえば、ここに運ばれてきたとき、ナイフを持ってたな。頭がまだぼんやりしてるかもしれないと思って、念のため預かっておいた。もう大丈夫そうだな。ほら、返すよ。

entries.EN: Thank you.
entries.JA_current: ありがとう。
entries.JA_new: ありがとう。

entries.EN: Task complete. Here's the artifact.
entries.JA_current: 任務完了だ。これがそのアーティファクトだ。
entries.JA_new: 任務完了だ。ほら、アーティファクトだ。

entries.EN: Great, Marked One. One more little favor and we're even.
entries.JA_current: すばらしいぞ、Marked One。もう一つの小さな贈り物を持って来れれば、俺たちゃ対等になれる。
entries.JA_new: よくやった、マークド・ワン。あと一つ頼みを聞いてくれたら、これで貸し借りなしだ。

entries.EN: What favor?
entries.JA_current: 贈り物って何だ？
entries.JA_new: 頼みって何だ？

entries.EN: Here, take it.
entries.JA_current: ほら、受け取れよ。
entries.JA_new: ほら、持ってけ。

entries.EN: Good...We'll consider that you passed the test. I'd suggest you avoid going to the rookie camp.
entries.JA_current: よろしい… お前はテストにパスしたものと考える。お前ならルーキーキャンプに行かなくていいだろうよ。
entries.JA_new: よし……これで試験に合格したと認めよう。ルーキー村には行かない方がいい。

entries.EN: So, did you bring the artifact?
entries.JA_current: それで、アーティファクトを持ってきたのか？
entries.JA_new: それで、アーティファクトは持ってきたか？

entries.EN: Not yet.
entries.JA_current: まだだ。
entries.JA_new: まだだ。

entries.EN: Well, until you bring it, we've got nothing to talk about. Got it?
entries.JA_current: お前があれを持ってこない限り、何についても話さないぞ。わかったか？
entries.JA_new: 持ってくるまで、話すことはない。分かったか？

entries.EN: Marked One, I've told you everything already. Get outta here!
entries.JA_current: Marked One、俺は既に全部話したぞ。とっとと ここから出て行け！
entries.JA_new: マークド・ワン、もう全部話した。さっさと出ていけ！

entries.EN: I see... Well, I'll give you a piece of advice then. Free of charge, but not free of sense. What is the most important thing in the Zone? It's not money, it's information! Keeps you away from trouble, and points you towards loot. You got a PDA yet? Every stalker uses a PDA, you can receive, send and store information just like that. Quite often stalkers will share tips, advice and suggestions for finding loot on the global chat. Someone will see an untouched body somewhere and share location, there's an opportunity for you to search for a stash right there. \n \nOf course, shit happens out here all the time, and you'll run into dead stalkers. Pick up their PDA and download info from it, some people will even buy PDAs off you for a decent price, depends on who owned it. Data transfer is very simple and every PDA contains a decoder so you can simply just press a button and transfer info onto your PDA. This includes map markers indicating stashes hidden around the Zone. All sorts of goodies within them.

entries.JA_new: そうか……じゃあ、ひとつ助言してやる。タダだが、役には立つぞ。ゾーンで一番大切なものは何だ？金じゃない。情報だ！危険を避けて、獲物のありかを教えてくれる。もうPDAは持ってるか？ストーカーなら誰でも持ってる。情報を受け取ったり送ったり、保存したりできるんだ。ストーカー同士で全体チャットに、獲物の見つけ方や助言をよく書き込んでる。誰かが手つかずの死体を見つけて場所を共有すれば、すぐ近くの隠し場所を探すチャンスになる。 \n \nもちろん、ここじゃ何が起きてもおかしくない。死んだストーカーに出くわすこともある。そいつのPDAを拾って情報を読み取れ。持ち主によっては、PDAを高値で買い取る奴もいる。データの転送は簡単だ。PDAにはデコーダーが入ってるから、ボタンを押すだけで情報を自分のPDAへ移せる。ゾーンに隠された物資の場所を示す地図マーカーも含まれてる。中にはお宝がたっぷりだ。

entries.EN: To Cordon.
entries.JA_current: To Cordon.
entries.JA_new: コルドン行きか。

entries.EN:
I can arrange to have a little rust bucket "Goatling" delivered to the car park for you. It's seen some use, but it's still got 4 wheels and for only 9000 rubles! I need the cash up front, no refunds!\n \n
		Or if that's too risky for you, feel free to take that ZAPOR by the last house... If you manage to start it, he-he!..

entries.JA_new:
ポンコツの「ゴートリング」を駐車場に回してやれるぞ。使い古しだが、車輪は四つ付いてる。たった9,000ルーブルだ！前払いで、返金はなし！\n \n
		それが怖いなら、最後の家のそばにある「ザポル」に乗ってもいい。エンジンがかかればの話だがな、へへっ！

entries.EN: Well... So be it, bring me the "rust bucket"...
entries.JA_current: Well... So be it, bring me the "rust bucket"...
entries.JA_new: そうか……なら、その「ポンコツ」を頼む。

entries.EN: Damn, quite the racket you're running! Forget about it... I'll stick to the mud.
entries.JA_current: Damn, quite the racket you're running! Forget about it... I'll stick to the mud.
entries.JA_new: なんてぼったくりだ！やめとく……泥道を歩くよ。

entries.EN: The "Goatling" is yours. Pick it up in the garage at the car factory.
entries.JA_current: The "Goatling" is yours. Pick it up in the garage at the car factory.
entries.JA_new: 「ゴートリング」はあんたのものだ。自動車工場のガレージで受け取れ。

entries.EN: To the Garbage.
entries.JA_current: To the Garbage.
entries.JA_new: ガーベジ行きか。

entries.EN: To the Garbage... Aha... There's a "Moskvitch-2141, and an UAZik. Money upfront, as usual.
entries.JA_current: To the Garbage... Aha... There's a "Moskvitch-2141, and an UAZik. Money upfront, as usual.
entries.JA_new: ガーベジ行きだな……なるほど……「モスクヴィッチ2141」とUAZがある。いつも通り、代金は前払いだ。

entries.EN: Let it be "Moskvich"...
entries.JA_current: Let it be "Moskvich"...
entries.JA_new: 「モスクヴィッチ」にするか……

entries.EN: The "Moskvich" is yours. You'll find it at the machinery scrapyard.
entries.JA_current: The "Moskvich" is yours. You'll find it at the machinery scrapyard.
entries.JA_new: 「モスクヴィッチ」はあんたのものだ。車両置き場にある。

entries.EN: Arrange the UAZ.
entries.JA_current: Arrange the UAZ.
entries.JA_new: UAZを手配してくれ。

entries.EN: Deal. It'll be standing by those ruins in front of the Duty roadblock.
entries.JA_current: Deal. It'll be standing by those ruins in front of the Duty roadblock.
entries.JA_new: 分かった。デューティーの検問所の手前、廃墟のそばに置いておく。

entries.EN: On second thought, forget about it...
entries.JA_current: On second thought, forget about it...
entries.JA_new: やっぱり、やめておく……

entries.EN: To the Agroprom.
entries.JA_current: To the Agroprom.
entries.JA_new: アフロプロム行きか。

entries.EN: So... I can have either a UAZ "Goatling" or a "Niva" delivered. That or you can try to "appropriate" a Moskvich from the military... He-he-he...
entries.JA_current: So... I can have either a UAZ "Goatling" or a "Niva" delivered. That or you can try to "appropriate" a Moskvich from the military... He-he-he...
entries.JA_new: そうだな……UAZ「ゴートリング」か「ニーヴァ」を手配できる。あるいは軍からモスクヴィッチを「借りて」くるか。へへへ……

entries.EN: Let it be the UAZik... Better be worth it...
entries.JA_current: Let it be the UAZik... Better be worth it...
entries.JA_new: UAZでいい……値段分の価値があるといいが。

entries.EN: Pick it up by the railroad tunnel. Get lost!
entries.JA_current: Pick it up by the railroad tunnel. Get lost!
entries.JA_new: 線路脇のトンネルまで取りに来い。ほら、行った行った！

entries.EN: Arrange a "Niva".
entries.JA_current: Arrange a "Niva".
entries.JA_new: 「ニーヴァ」を手配してくれ。

entries.EN: You'll find it on the road from the institute...
entries.JA_current: You'll find it on the road from the institute...
entries.JA_new: 研究所から続く道に置いてある……

entries.EN: When will you finally stop robbing people, I wonder...
entries.JA_current: When will you finally stop robbing people, I wonder...
entries.JA_new: いつになったら人から金を巻き上げるのをやめるんだか……

entries.EN: To the Dark Valley.
entries.JA_current: To the Dark Valley.
entries.JA_new: ダークバレー行きか。

entries.EN: You may have a "brick" delivered there. For 15'000 only. The place is rather dangerous, you know, so the price has to reflect that, you understand.
entries.JA_current: You may have a "brick" delivered there. For 15'000 only. The place is rather dangerous, you know, so the price has to reflect that, you understand.
entries.JA_new: あそこには「ブリック」を回せる。たった1万5,000ルーブルだ。危険な場所だからな、その分の料金ってわけだ。分かるだろ？

entries.EN: Well, ok then...
entries.JA_current: Well, ok then...
entries.JA_new: まあ、いいか……

entries.EN: The "brick" will be waiting for you at the gas station, opposite Borov's camp.
entries.JA_current: The "brick" will be waiting for you at the gas station, opposite Borov's camp.
entries.JA_new: 「ブリック」はボロフのキャンプ向かいのガソリンスタンドで待たせておく。

entries.EN: Whoops... I've changed my mind...
entries.JA_current: Whoops... I've changed my mind...
entries.JA_new: おっと……やっぱり気が変わった。

entries.EN: To the Bar.
entries.JA_current: To the Bar.
entries.JA_new: ロストク行きか。

entries.EN: To the Bar... It's going to be a "Niva". For 12'000 cash up front.
entries.JA_current: To the Bar... It's going to be a "Niva". For 12'000 cash up front.
entries.JA_new: ロストク行きなら「ニーヴァ」だな。前払いで1万2,000ルーブル。

entries.EN: Why so much? Well, ok, arrange it, please...
entries.JA_current: Why so much? Well, ok, arrange it, please...
entries.JA_new: 高すぎるな……まあいい、手配してくれ。

entries.EN: Pick it up on the road, by the gas tanker.
entries.JA_current: Pick it up on the road, by the gas tanker.
entries.JA_new: 道路脇、燃料タンク車のそばで受け取れ。

entries.EN: That's too much money... Maybe another time.
entries.JA_current: That's too much money... Maybe another time.
entries.JA_new: そんな金はない……また今度にする。

entries.EN: To Yantar.
entries.JA_current: To Yantar.
entries.JA_new: ヤンター行きか。

entries.EN: Very nice! I can get a "Lop-eared" over-there for you! Small and unreliable! But for 8'000 only!
entries.JA_current: Very nice! I can get a "Lop-eared" over-there for you! Small and unreliable! But for 8'000 only!
entries.JA_new: いいぞ！「ロップイヤー」を回してやる。小さくて頼りない車だが、たった8,000ルーブルだ！

entries.EN: Let it be the "lop-eared" then... Hope I don't regret this...
entries.JA_current: Let it be the "lop-eared" then... Hope I don't regret this...
entries.JA_new: じゃあ「ロップイヤー」で……後悔しないといいが。

entries.EN: Have it! You'll see it as soon as you enter the canyon.
entries.JA_current: Have it! You'll see it as soon as you enter the canyon.
entries.JA_new: ほら、やるよ！峡谷に入ればすぐ見つかる。

entries.EN: Actually, maybe we can try later..
entries.JA_current: Actually, maybe we can try later..
entries.JA_new: いや、また今度にする……

entries.EN: No way!
entries.JA_current: No way!
entries.JA_new: 冗談じゃない！

entries.EN: The stalkers are... ermm... stalking me! Can you help with the matter?
entries.JA_current: The stalkers are... ermm... stalking me! Can you help with the matter?
entries.JA_new: ストーカーどもに追い回されてるんだ！何とかしてくれないか？

entries.EN: I can, but the service is not a cheap one. I can settle the matter for 20'000. Do you agree?
entries.JA_current: I can, but the service is not a cheap one. I can settle the matter for 20'000. Do you agree?
entries.JA_new: できるが、安くはないぞ。2万ルーブルで話をつけてやる。どうする？

entries.EN: I do. I want the stalkers off my back.
entries.JA_current: I do. I want the stalkers off my back.
entries.JA_new: 頼む。ストーカーどもに付きまとわれるのはもうごめんだ。

entries.EN: No. I don't really care enough to fork over that much.
entries.JA_current: No. I don't really care enough to fork over that much.
entries.JA_new: いや、そこまで金を払ってどうにかする気はない。

entries.EN: Yeah, that's it!
entries.JA_current: Yeah, that's it!
entries.JA_new: そう、それだ！

entries.EN: Heh! Were you born yesterday?
entries.JA_current: Heh! Were you born yesterday?
entries.JA_new: へっ！昨日生まれたばかりか？

entries.EN: That's almost true, I'm telling you.
entries.JA_current: That's almost true, I'm telling you.
entries.JA_new: 本当の話に近いんだよ、聞いてくれ。

entries.EN: Well, I see. Thank you.
entries.JA_current: Well, I see. Thank you.
entries.JA_new: なるほどな。ありがとう。

entries.EN: I see. Any more info?
entries.JA_current: I see. Any more info?
entries.JA_new: そうか。他に何か分かったか？

entries.EN: On my way...
entries.JA_current: On my way...
entries.JA_new: 今行く……

entries.EN: So, have you brought the artifact?
entries.JA_current: So, have you brought the artifact?
entries.JA_new: それで、アーティファクトは持ってきたか？

entries.EN: What kind of favor?
entries.JA_current: What kind of favor?
entries.JA_new: どんな頼みだ？
